subject: A satirical portrait of a British district officer as the traditional Kalighat hypocrite-cat. A plump self-satisfied Englishman in a solar topi and buttoned white drill jacket stands in profile, chin lifted, clutching a bundle of official files under one arm. He wears the pious expression of a holy man, while behind his back his other hand holds a fat fish. Gentle, unmistakable mockery.
